obligor_aliases: Verity Health System of California, Inc.
_notes: HISTORICAL OBLIGOR — included for blind-context completeness. Filed Chapter 11 Aug 31 2018, Central District CA, after losses of ~$175M/yr and >$1B aggregate. $459.2M long-term debt + $254M pension liabilities at FYE June 30 2017. 6 hospitals in LA + SF Bay sold piecemeal during 2019-2020 (Pipeline Health, Strategic Global Mgmt/Prime). Defunct as operating system. Pre-petition Moody's was Caa3 (DEFAULTED tier).

moodys.citation_text: Chapter 11 filed Aug 31 2018; prior Moody's pre-petition rating in Caa range. By 2022 obligor was defunct/dissolved.
